claims.text: Reliance interventions reduce over-reliance on Large Language Model advice.
Reliance interventions generally fail to improve appropriate reliance on Large Language Models.
Users become more confident after making wrong reliance decisions in certain contexts.
Users demonstrate poor calibration when making wrong reliance decisions.

evidence.description: Our findings indicate that while interventions reduce over-reliance...
...they generally fail to improve appropriate reliance.
Furthermore, people became more confident after making wrong reliance decisions in certain contexts...

methodologies.name: Randomized online experiment
methodologies.description: A randomized online experiment with 400 participants completing tasks before and after receiving modified LLM advice under three reliance interventions.
conditions: Two-stage task workflow (independent answer followed by post-advice answer)

limitations.text: Tested reliance interventions generally fail to improve appropriate reliance.
Existing reliance interventions for LLM users lack rigorous evaluation for appropriate reliance.

future_work.text: Designing effective reliance interventions for human-LLM collaboration informed by user calibration findings.
